title: Spiritual experiences don’t always equal spiritual maturity.
paragraphs: Spiritual experiences don’t always equal spiritual maturity.

In Acts, tongues appeared as fire fell.
In 1 Corinthians, Paul asked hard questions.

The apostles experienced power.
Paul insisted on order.

Power gathered the crowd.
Order built the church.

One moment birthed awe.
The other guarded growth.

Tongues appeared in Acts.
But Paul asked, “Do all speak in tongues?”

Not everything that is powerful is profitable.
Not everything that is loud is lasting.
What builds the church more — expression or edification?
📖 “Let all things be done for edification.” — 1 Corinthians 14:26
“Is tongues evidence, a gift, or optional?”
